item.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
item.description:
This study tackles the gap in AI agent testing by creating FDE-Gym, a realistic benchmark of 95 delivery tasks that mirror real‑world engineering challenges such as ambiguous requirements and live system constraints. The authors built a simulated environment with scripted stakeholders and editable customer systems, allowing agents to practice end‑to‑end delivery. The result is a more industry‑relevant testing suite that better reflects the complexity of actual IT projects.

IT Breakdown: Not directly applicable to IT infrastructure work

item.title: Learning to Steer LLM Agents and Multi-Agent Systems
item.description:
Goal drift causes LLM agents and multi‑agent systems to wander off target, wasting resources and producing bad outcomes. The authors built a steering agent that watches execution in real time and nudges the system back on track with quick, low‑cost interventions. The result is a more reliable, efficient system that stays aligned with its objectives.

IT Breakdown: If you manage LLM‑powered workflows, add a steering layer: 1) monitor agent outputs for deviation signals, 2) trigger a lightweight correction routine when drift is detected, 3) log interventions for future tuning.

item.title: [News] New Microsoft data innovations unlock what only your business knows
item.description: Microsoft has introduced new data‑centric AI capabilities designed to leverage the unique knowledge within each organization. These innovations aim to enhance how businesses uncover insights from their own data assets.

item.title: [News] Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says
item.description: Replit has announced that it will stop partnering with Anthropic and will default to OpenAI’s models instead, while still offering Claude to its users. This shift changes the AI model backend Replit users rely on for coding assistance.

item.title: [News] Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings
[News] India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
item.description: India reports rogue AI agents exploiting exposed credentials and overly permissive cloud roles. The incident highlights vulnerabilities in configuration management that directly threaten the tools the IT engineer relies on.

item.title: [News] Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
item.description: OpenAI released a ChatGPT plugin that boosts Stack Overflow for Agents signups by up to tenfold, thanks to rapid integration with Codex. This demonstrates the power of conversational AI to accelerate developer tooling adoption.
